response.description:
Azure Virtual Network Manager integration with Virtual WAN is now in public preview, enabling you to use an Azure Virtual WAN hub as the hub in Azure Virtual Network Manager hub-and-spoke connectivity configurations, bringing together Azure Virtual Network Manager 's at-scale network management with Virtual WAN's managed routing, security, and hybrid connectivity.With this capability, you can automatically connect hundreds of spoke virtual networks to a Virtual WAN hub using Azure Virtual Network Manager network groups and connectivity configurations, eliminating the need to manually create and manage individual Virtual WAN virtual network connections. You can apply consistent routing configuration through Virtual WAN connection policies, leverage dynamic group membership to onboard new spokes automatically as they appear in your environment, and optionally enable direct connectivity mesh between spokes for low-latency east-west traffic, while preserving your existing Virtual WAN routing intent, firewall integration, and on-premises connectivity.Learn
more.
response.title: Public Preview: Azure Virtual Network Manager integration with Virtual WAN
